description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ContactAccessor that provides an SDK-independent API for accessing contact information on Android devices. It includes methods for obtaining contact data and selecting contacts, with implementation selection based on the device's API level.

classes.name: ContactAccessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing SDK-independent methods for contact access, with implementations varying based on Android API level.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ContactAccessor, instantiating the appropriate SDK-specific subclass based on the device's API level.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Abstract method to get an Intent for picking a contact, configured for the appropriate authority.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Abstract method to load contact data from a given URI using ContentResolver.
